# TED-RAG animation dependency

`context_builder.py` is an unchanged snapshot of the development workspace's
`rag/context_builder.py`, bundled for standalone clones and recovery. It blends
weighted authored motion constraints using only the Python standard library.
The game does not need the research corpus, an index, model weights or credentials.

The sibling development copy remains preferred when present. Without either
Python or the builder, the existing local animation fallback keeps gameplay
running.
